card.name: Risk-factor history lists in warnings
card.fires_on: The word right after a risk-history phrase, such as 'traveled in/to', 'resided or traveled', or 'a family' before 'history of'. It appears in precaution lists of patient risk factors.

modes.label: Travel to endemic areas
modes.description: The verb or preposition after 'resided or traveled' that leads into areas or countries with endemic tuberculosis.
modes.example: who have resided or traveled<< in>> areas of endemic tuberculosis or endemic mycos

modes.label: Family history
modes.description: The word 'family' just before 'history of' a heart rhythm or metabolic condition.
modes.example: or with a<< family>> history of diabetes or glaucoma,
